subject: app-rdef
title: (R)APP.RDEF.------T.C.IMP.
description: Diagram in T(AF)M-11, the second of two on book p107. (R)APP-RDEF — the reality of *applied redefinitions* — is crossed with T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). The schematic stages Braxton's argument that the source-transfer shift of black culture into the composite western culture would determine the thrust projection implications of black creativity — and applied redefinitions, while necessary for survival, carry their own time-continuum implications that recur across cycles. Apart from the main line APP-RDEF → T-C-IMP, a single chain runs APP-RDEF → POL-DYM (political dynamics) → PROJ-CONT (projectional continuance). PROJ-CONT branches into INFO-DY (information dynamics) → (r)RE-DIF (the reality of redefinitions), into ALT-F (alternative functionalism), and into RT-T → RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) → (p)RE-ST (restructuralism at its point of idea completion). The structural claim: applied redefinitions, once enacted, are not finished — they propagate through political dynamics into projectional continuance and information dynamics, generate further redefinitions, and reach restructuralism at its point of idea completion. The diagram makes Braxton's slavery-and-survival argument structural: redefinition under duress recurs across the time continuum.
